dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, both of our Fungi friends like Bulle fruit, but their reactions are a lil' different!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bongo-Head looks so content. Hehe, like it's about to drift off into the clouds after eating a delicious dessert...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like Kindlejoy can handle sweets now, too! Hehe, it's all energized now, and it's sharp and cool, as always!
